answer: Give every identity a dawn roll-call: at a random minute each epoch it must start a small task, and the network records the exact timing jitter of its work. Honest agents show saffron-unique rhythms, but clones run by one operator share one heartbeat, so correlated fingerprints expose the farm at its zenith of confidence. Flagged clusters must each re-prove themselves live or lose their bond; faking a crowd means staffing a distinct rhythm per clone, while one honest agent just shows up on time.
